text: dsh-win-toast-notify 是面向 Windows 的 DSH 插件，在 Host 侧监听 session/event 事件流，并在一轮对话结束时发出系统原生 Toast 通知。通知可显示结束原因、会话标题、最后一条助手回复预览和耗时；默认跳过子代理会话，也可按配置选择结束原因、预览长度和提示音。适合需要切换窗口仍想知道 DSH 任务状态的用户。需要 Windows PowerShell 与系统通知可用；其他平台不会发送通知。

dsh-win-toast-notify listens for DSH turn-end events on Windows and sends a native toast with the reason, session title, reply preview, and duration. It skips subagents by default and supports configurable reasons, preview length, and sound. Requires Windows PowerShell and system notifications.
想让 DSH 每轮结束时在 Windows 桌面弹出通知。
切到别的窗口后，怎么知道助手这轮有没有完成？
Can I get a Windows desktop alert when a DSH turn finishes?
dsh-win-toast-notify 的功能「回合结束通知」：在 Host 收到匹配的 turn/end 事件时发送 Windows 原生 Toast，展示结束原因、会话标题、助手回复预览及耗时；默认不通知子代理会话。

dsh-win-toast-notify README · dsh-win-toast-notify：Native Windows toast notification every time a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) turn finishes — so you can look away from the window while the agent works.

```
任务完成 · Fix the login redirect
Updated the middleware and added two regression tests; all 41 tests pass.
DeepSeek Harness · 用时 4 分 12 秒
```

Line 1 is the end reason plus the session title, line 2 is a preview of the turn's final reply, line 3 is where it came from and how long the turn took.

dsh-win-toast-notify README · Requirements：- Windows 10 or 11 (uses the built-in WinRT notification API through Windows PowerShell — no native module, no build step, no install script).
- A Harness build that emits the `session/event` feed with `turn/end` (dsh 0.2.x).
- Notifications enabled for the app the toast is posted under; Focus assist / Do not disturb suppresses it like any other notification.

dsh-win-toast-notify README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-win-toast-notify
```

or install it from the [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) plugin browser. Restart Harness if your build does not reload plugin rows live.

dsh-win-toast-notify README · What triggers a toast：The Host half listens to each Session's durable event feed and reacts to `turn/end`:

| `turn/end` reason | Notified by default |
| --- | --- |
| `completed` | yes — "任务完成" |
| `error` | yes — "任务出错" |
| `blocked` | yes — "任务受阻" |
| `max-tokens` | yes — "输出达到上限" |
| `interrupted` | yes — "任务被中断" |
| `aborted` (you pressed Stop) | no |
| `forked` | no |

Subagent sessions are skipped by default so a fan-out does not ring once per child.

dsh-win-toast-notify README · Configuration：Edit the row's `config` in the profile patch (or the plugin's settings card), then restart:

```yaml
- id: dsh-win-toast-notify
  name: dsh-win-toast-notify
  config:
    enabled: true                 # master switch

dsh-win-toast-notify README · How it works：- **Read-only observer.** The plugin subscribes to `session/event` and keeps only the turn's start time and its last assistant text in memory. It appends no events and writes no files, so fork, resume and replay are untouched.
- **Host-side only.** No Client module, no DOM, no iframe: the toast is raised by the Host, so it also fires when the Web GUI is in a background tab or closed.
- **Toast delivery.** `notify()` builds a ToastGeneric XML payload and runs `powershell.exe -EncodedCommand` (UTF-16LE + Base64) against the WinRT `Windows.UI.Notifications` API, so arbitrary text — Chinese, quotes, newlines — cannot break the command line.
- **App identity.** Toasts are posted under `com.deepseek.dsh` when the desktop app's Start-menu shortcut is present, which makes them appear as DeepSeek Harness. On a plain `dsh web` or CLI install that AUMID is unregistered and Windows drops the toast silently, so the plugin falls back to the Windows PowerShell AUMID instead.

dsh-win-toast-notify README · Limitations：- Windows only. On other platforms the plugin loads and does nothing.
- The toast is attributed to whichever app the AUMID belongs to; with the fallback it shows as Windows PowerShell in Action Center.
- Preview text is plain text: Markdown fences, links, emphasis and inline code are stripped.
